html: I. מלך (√ of foll.; meaning dub.; Thes comp. Arabic مَلَكَ possess, own exclusively, cf. Ethiopic መለከ so BaeRel. 144 (cf. בַּעַל), and NöZMG xl. 1886, 727; LyonBib. Sacr., Apr. 1884 DlProl. 30 al. comp. Assyrian malâku, counsel, advise DlHWB 412, BH and NH מָלַךְ, Aramaic ܡܠܰܟ, מְלַךְ, whence king as orig. counsellor, he whose opinion is decisive).
